sections.heading: UPSC One Time Registration (OTR) rules for NDA & CDS.
body: UPSC's application portal (upsconline.nic.in) handles NDA (National Defence Academy) and CDS (Combined Defence Services) exams.
All uploaded documents must be PDF format, un-password-protected, and strictly between 20 KB (minimum) and 300 KB (maximum).

faq.q: What is the document file size range for UPSC NDA & CDS applications?
faq.a: Uploaded PDF documents on upsconline.nic.in must be between 20 KB and 300 KB in file size.
